infotexts.entitydescription.combatmultitool: Two-handed ricocheting energy-ring emitter and shield. Requires Lua for Barotrauma. One cell or fuel rod powers weapons, shield, light and tools. Quality grants 1/2/3/4 bounces. Players disable NPC damage to weld/cut. Extinguisher takes priority over firing. Bots automatically select combat or one technical function for their actual task.
infotexts.entitydescription.Multi-toolSET: A composite tool; toggle welder/cutter, shine a built-in flashlight beam, enable extinguisher mode, and use a shared oxygen tank.
infotexts.entitydescription.wrenchscrewdrivertwoin: Designed for submarine engineers, double right-click to switch wrenches/screwdrivers.
